    Proposition 12.8 for A₀ and for a representation-finite algebra #

    prop:polynomial-mesh-comparison (deformation-refinements.tex): "Let m + Σ_{i∈I} t_i μ_i be an associative family satisfying the hypotheses of Proposition 7.9, such as eq. selected-binary-family, now indexed by I = I₀. There are polynomial lifts […] for which the retained mesh coefficients are F_i(t) = a_i t_i, a_i ∈ k^*. After every specialization to k, these modules exhaust the indecomposables of the fibre algebra."

    In the setting of Proposition 7.9 (familyCriterion_A0): the rows R_i and dual mesh weights of Proposition 6.1 (rows of length at least three, the degree 2s + 2 of Proposition 6.1), the characters χ_i (rowChar), and a family μ_i indexed by all rows with the hypotheses of Proposition 7.9 (normalized relative, of character χ_i, not a coboundary, associative family). The internal degree len R_i − 2 of μ_i is derived from its character (RaySys.Sys.hasDeg₂_of_char), the coordinates χ_i ↦ e_i are the dual weights, and the generic polynomialMeshComparison applies (polynomialMeshComparison_A0); for A₀ of a representation-finite algebra the mesh hypotheses are the Auslander–Reiten ones (IndSkeleton.polynomialMeshComparison_ar).
